description: University of Auckland Lightly Reinforced Concrete Wall Tests is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Rick Henry, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). A series of experimental tests of large-scale lightly reinforced concrete walls were conducted at the University of Auckland. The test were used to investigate minimum vertical reinforcement provisions and formed the basis for revisions to the New Zealand Concrete Structures Standard (NZS 3101:2006 (A3)) and the US Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete (ACI 318-19). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tshe-kd83. Keywords: reinforced concrete, wall, seismic design, minimum vertical reinforcement, plastic hinge region, reinforcement buckling. Published 2019-10-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
